description: This PHP source file defines the class 'actionCreateRecord' which extends 'actionBase'. It provides methods for loading JavaScript, rendering an HTML form for creating records, executing the create record action, setting record fields, managing relationships, copying email addresses, and validating email addresses within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework.

classes.name: actionCreateRecord
classes.description: A class for creating and managing record creation actions within SuiteCRM, including form rendering, record creation, relationship management, and email address handling.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript file path associated with this action.

methods.name: edit_display
methods.description: Generates HTML for the record creation form, including fields for record type, relationships, and email copying options.

methods.name: run_action
methods.description: Executes the creation of a new record based on provided parameters, manages relationships, and handles email copying.

methods.name: set_record
methods.description: Sets fields on the new record based on parameters, including date calculations, user assignment, and other field types.

methods.name: set_relationships
methods.description: Establishes relationships between the new record and existing beans based on parameters.

methods.name: copyEmailAddresses
methods.description: Copies email addresses from one bean to another, validating email addresses.

methods.name: validateCurrentEmailAddress
methods.description: Validates the structure of an email address array.
